panels.title: Volume I/O by Instance Attachment
panels.description: One row per observed instance disk attachment at the selected range end. Read + write IOPS excludes flushes. Rates use Prometheus $__rate_interval; throughput converts the legacy GiB counters to bytes/s. Latency is service-time rate divided by request rate on the same attachment with matching sample counts. No I/O means both latency counters are present and the request rate is zero; Unavailable means missing, insufficient, stale or unhealthy telemetry. Rates require healthy scrape/Libvirt observations throughout the rate window. A selected Volume UUID filters disk panels only; All also includes local disks. RBD pool names are not Cinder volume types. Values describe compute-side I/O and must not be interpreted as backend Ceph-wide volume totals, especially for multi-attach volumes. An empty table can mean no matching observations or unavailable telemetry; check the visible coverage indicators.

panels.description:
